_note: Households a person's page must NOT take as parents, one named person at a time, read by scripts/build-dossiers.py. This is not the general fix for the name-only «unchecked» match (worklist 337, David's decision); it only withdraws a match shown to be wrong for one person. Each entry: the person's pid, the household's father and mother exactly as households.json writes them, the reason and the date.

refuse.why: A Vodnjan household with a daughter born about 1800, matched to the first man of the direct line by a first name alone (the household child has no year). His own register evidence is the Gologorica marriage of 9 June 1774 («q.m Leonardi filius»).

A Svetvinčenat household whose child «Giovanni» was baptised on 10 January 1756; matched by a first name alone and six years after the birth year the family chart gives the first man of the direct line.
